We need to generate unit test code covering cases described. Use JUnit5, Mockito. The focal method is public, so we can test via real JsonSchema instances or mocks. The existing test class already covers two basic cases. Need to expand to cover all groups: findSchemaResourceRoot, findSchemaResourceRoot_additional, findSchemaResourceRoot_exceptionPropagation. Also include cases for NullPointerException when parent null and not root, StackOverflowError for cyclic reference, IllegalStateException and IllegalArgumentException via mocks.

We need to create test class with @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class). Use mocking for JsonSchema to override isSchemaResourceRoot and getParentSchema behavior.

But JsonSchema is a concrete class; we can create a spy or mock subclass using Mockito.mock(JsonSchema.class, CALLS_REAL_METHODS) and stub methods.

However findSchemaResourceRoot uses isSchemaResourceRoot() and getParentSchema() methods. Those are defined in BaseJsonValidator? Not shown but likely public method getParentSchema() returns JsonSchema. We'll mock them.

Test cases:

1. root is resource root -> already covered but we can keep.

2. hierarchy of three schemas where only root true -> need to create mock chain: leaf false, middle false, root true. Use Mockito to create three mocks, stub getParentSchema appropriately, and isSchemaResourceRoot accordingly.

3. hierarchy where middle true, top true -> leaf false, middle true, top true. Should return middle.

4. NullPointerException when parent null and not root: leaf false, parent null (i.e., leaf's getParentSchema returns null). isSchemaResourceRoot false. Expect NPE.

5. Additional group: five-level hierarchy with only level5 true. Build chain of 5 mocks.

6. Two-level where parent true -> leaf false, parent true.

7. Four-level where leaf false, level2 false, level3 true, level4 true -> return level3.

8. Cyclic schema chain: schema whose getParentSchema returns itself. isSchemaResourceRoot false. Expect StackOverflowError.

9. Exception propagation: mock isSchemaResourceRoot to throw IllegalStateException; findSchemaResourceRoot should propagate.

10. Mock getParentSchema to throw IllegalArgumentException; propagate.

Implement tests using @Test and assertThrows for exception cases. For cyclic test, might need to limit recursion? It will cause infinite recursion until stack overflow; we can assertThrows(StackOverflowError.class) with timeout maybe. But JUnit may treat StackOverflowError as error not exception; we can use assertThrows(StackOverflowError.class, () -> schema.findSchemaResourceRoot());

Need to create helper method to build mock chain.

Implementation details:

private JsonSchema mockSchema(boolean isRoot, JsonSchema parent) { JsonSchema mock = Mockito.mock(JsonSchema.class); Mockito.when(mock.isSchemaResourceRoot()).thenReturn(isRoot); Mockito.when(mock.getParentSchema()).thenReturn(parent); // Also need to stub findSchemaResourceRoot? No, we call real method, but it's not stubbed, so we need to call real method. However mock's method findSchemaResourceRoot will be default (returns default null) unless we use CALLS_REAL_METHODS. So we need to create mock with CALLS_REAL_METHODS to use real implementation while stubbing other methods. Use Mockito.mock(JsonSchema.class, Mockito.CALLS_REAL_METHODS). Then stub isSchemaResourceRoot and getParentSchema.

Thus:

JsonSchema mock = Mockito.mock(JsonSchema.class, Mockito.CALLS_REAL_METHODS);
Mockito.when(mock.isSchemaResourceRoot()).thenReturn(isRoot);
Mockito.when(mock.getParentSchema()).thenReturn(parent);
